summary: First United Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K on September 24, 2026 announcing that its board declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.28 per share, payable November 2, 2026 to holders of record as of the close of business on October 19, 2026. The dividend is an ordinary capital-return action rather than a special situation, and no buyback, tender, or strategic transaction is disclosed. The registrant is the issuer of Nasdaq-listed common stock (FUNC); no advisor, premium, or deal terms are stated. Watch for ex-dividend trading around the record date.
